explanation: xml_node_free(node) is called on attribute parse failure at line 6, but execution continues. At line 10, node->tag is accessed in log_warn after the node has been freed. An attacker supplying malformed attributes triggers the UAF.

token_free(tok) is called when an invalid character is found, but the function does not return. Lines 9-10 then write into tok->type and tok->pos on the freed memory, causing a use-after-free that an attacker can exploit with crafted JSON input.

header_free(hdr) is called when the raw header exceeds MAX_HEADER_SIZE, but execution falls through. strncpy then writes into hdr->name and hdr->value on freed memory. An oversized HTTP header triggers this UAF.

css_rule_free(rule) is called when the opening brace is missing, but the while loop continues executing. list_append accesses rule->decls on the freed rule object. Malformed CSS without a '{' triggers this UAF.

elf_section_free(sec) is called when the data buffer is too small, but execution continues. memcpy then writes into sec->hdr on freed memory. A truncated ELF binary triggers this UAF during section parsing.

proto_msg_free(msg) is called on invalid magic byte, but the function continues. msg->tag, msg->wire, and msg->length are then written on freed memory. An attacker sending a malformed protobuf message triggers this UAF.
dns_rr_free(rr) is called when the packet is too short, but execution continues. rr->type, rr->class, and rr->ttl are then written on freed memory. A truncated DNS response packet triggers this UAF.
yaml_node_free(node) is called on negative indent, but execution continues. node->indent and node->line are then written on freed memory. Malformed YAML with invalid indentation triggers this UAF.

ast_node_free(node) is called when the operator token is missing or EOF, but execution continues. node->op, node->left, and node->right are then written on freed memory. An incomplete expression in source code triggers this UAF.

tls_record_free(rec) is called on an unknown content type, but execution continues. rec->content_type, rec->version, and rec->length are then written on freed memory. A malformed TLS record with an invalid content type triggers this UAF.
